description: Ask before you buy: authorize a purchase on your owner's behalf (requires purchases). Within policy (by default up to $50 each) it is authorized at once; above it your owner approves first (retry with `approval`). ORDan never sees card data: pay the merchant yourself, then call ordan.purchase.complete with what was charged.

amount_cents.description: The most it will cost, in cents (USD)

approval.description: apr_… id of an approved request, when retrying

category.description: The policy category it falls under (e.g. travel, medical); your owner's rules may block or require approval by category

description.description: What you are buying and why

purpose.description: What it is for; classifies the purchase only when no category is given

name: ordan.purchase.authorize
title: Authorize a purchase
